suppress.notes: Wrong product. io.micrometer:micrometer-registry-prometheus is Micrometer's Prometheus exposition registry. dependency-check matches it to cpe:/a:prometheus:prometheus, the Prometheus server, and compares Micrometer's 1.x version with the server's. CVE-2026-42154 (the server's /api/v1/read endpoint before 3.5.3) and CVE-2019-3826 (server UI XSS before 2.7.1) are in code this jar does not contain, and so is anything else filed against the server.

Wrong product. gradle-plugin-<version>.jar is this fork's Play 1 Gradle plugin (org.playframework:gradle-plugin, versioned with the framework), which `ant package` publishes into framework/gradle-plugin-repo. dependency-check matches it to cpe:/a:gradle:gradle, Gradle itself, and compares the plugin's 1.13.x with Gradle's version ranges, which reports every Gradle CVE before 7.x. The jar holds the plugin's own classes and no Gradle code.

Right product, wrong language. CVE-2026-0994 is a recursion-depth bypass in google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() in the Python package, for protobuf releases up to 33.4. protobuf-java 4.36.x is release 36.x of the Java runtime; dependency-check compares "4.36.x" with 33.4 and finds it lower. Suppressed by CVE, so protobuf CVEs that do apply to protobuf-java still report.

Right project, other implementations. io.opentelemetry.proto:opentelemetry-proto is the Java binding of the OTLP protocol definitions. dependency-check matches it to cpe:/a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry, and these CVEs are filed against that CPE with a target_sw of another language: CVE-2026-39882 and CVE-2026-41178 against OpenTelemetry-Go, CVE-2026-40894 against OpenTelemetry .NET, CVE-2026-44967 against OpenTelemetry-cpp and CVE-2026-54285 against opentelemetry-js. Suppressed by CVE, so a CVE against OpenTelemetry Java still reports.
